{{Top|leg}}
'''L-3PO''' was a [[Gender/Legends|masculine programmed]] [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] astrocartographer [[Essio Galassian]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He tried to stop [[Scarlet Hark]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Baasen Ray]], and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] from entering Galassian's chambers, but Hark blew him to pieces with her blaster. He mentioned a mysterious Garden Party that Hark had attended, disguised as an artistic tutor.
